howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reviews project skills by first reading claude-plugins-guide or codex-plugins-guide, then checking that skill dir names match skill names and layouts are consistent; frontmatter review left to review-skill.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to review skill directory structure, naming, or file layout consistency in a project.

say_en.text: Check if skill directory names and file layouts in the project are compliant.
Review this repository's skill structure against the claude-plugins-guide.
say_en.note: Loads the corresponding guide as reference.

say_en.text: See whether skill directories match skill names and layouts are consistent.
say_en.note: Performs directory structure and layout checks.
